title: 第十一章 能量引导术
content_zh:
第二日，老宅大门处。
李洛目送着姜青娥的车辇远去，在其身旁，刘叔束手而立，除此之外，还有着身材高挑丰腴的蔡薇。
“呼。”
李洛望着车队消失在视野中，然后迎着朝霞轻吐了一口气，转头对着刘叔道：“刘叔，帮我跟学府请一周的假吧，我想要在家里休养一段时间。”
眼下的他，因为融合那后天之相的缘故，导致气血极差，这种状态去了学府，怕是反而引来闲言碎语。
现在他拥有了水相，最紧要的还是先寻找一部能量引导术修炼，将自身的相力等级提升起来。
而南风学府虽说也有着不少的修炼能量引导术，但置换条件颇多，还不如他自家的藏书阁来的方便。
只不过下个月就是大考了，他这个时间段请假一周，恐怕也会在学府中引起不小的议论，不过这个时候，李洛显然也顾不了这些了。
“是，少府主。”老实本分的刘叔闻言，立即应了下来。
“蔡薇姐。”李洛说完，目光又是转向了一旁的蔡薇。
蔡薇有些狭长妩媚的美目看来，矜持的微笑道：“少府主有什么吩咐？”
“还请你帮我采购一些灵水奇光，要四品品阶的。”李洛笑道。
蔡薇浓密的睫毛眨了眨，灵水奇光都是用来提升相的品阶的，可李洛似乎是天生空相，要这个做什么？
不过虽然心中疑惑，但她还是应了下来，声音酥柔的道：“少府主需要几份？”
李洛想了想，道：“先采购五十份吧。”
饶是蔡薇是个颇为冷静理智的熟女，可这五十份落入耳中，也是让得她一脸愕然的盯着李洛，似乎是感觉自己听错了。
“少府主，你说的是，五十份四品等级的灵水奇光？”蔡薇忍不住的重复了一下。
李洛迎着她惊愕的目光，认真的点点头。
蔡薇贝齿轻轻咬了咬性感红唇，灵水奇光是一种价格不菲的东西，而四品的灵水奇光价格更是不低，在市面上的价格，一份大概是一千枚天量金，而五十份，就是五万枚天量金。
洛岚府在整个天蜀郡内，诸多商会，产业加起来，每年的收入则是在三十万枚天量金左右，而这种情况还随着这些年洛岚府的状况在逐渐的降低。

当然其实天量金的多少不算太大的问题，洛岚府好歹算是家大业大，五万天量金还不至于让蔡薇失态，只是这一下子采购五十份四品灵水奇光，着实是显得有些奇葩。
因为灵水奇光主要的作用就是用以淬洗自身相性，提升其品阶，可众所周知，灵水奇光中蕴含着一些各种材料融合时所产生的杂质，这种杂质会渐渐的侵蚀相宫，所以日积月累下，就会导致相宫逐渐的封闭，到了这个时候，相性的提升就算是达到了极致。
很多人在使用灵水奇光时，都不会毫无节制的使用，一般会控制在有序的时间中，比如说一个月使用一两份左右，这样不仅会减少杂质影响自身相宫，也能够最大化的利用灵水奇光的淬洗之力。
所以，就算旁人要购买灵水奇光，都是小量购买，类似李洛这种一次性买五十份的，这是要存够几年的量吗？
蔡薇实在是不能理解李洛这么做究竟是为了什么...
不过李洛毕竟是少府主，而且姜青娥也说了，她留在这里主要就是为了配合李洛，于是她最后还是轻轻点头。
“好的。”
“那就麻烦蔡薇姐了。”李洛温和的笑了笑，然后便是转身进了老宅中。
蔡薇望着他的背影，有些无奈的轻叹了一口气，这位少府主，似乎有些乱来啊，经过昨天的事情，难道他还不知道洛岚府如今算是内忧外患吗？
就算因为身体的原因，他没有办法为青娥分忧，可也没必要添乱吧？按照他这种胡乱挥霍的手法，洛岚府每年在天蜀郡的收入，未必就经得起折腾多久啊。
难道到时候还得向姜青娥申请援助吗？可如今的洛岚府处境不好，同样也是需要大量资金的时候啊。
蔡薇轻轻揉了揉眉心，看来这段时间在天蜀郡，她或许不会过得太过的顺心了。
而对于蔡薇的诸多心理情绪，李洛倒是没有过于的去理会，此时的他，正怀着一些兴奋与期待，直接前往了老宅中的藏书阁。
藏书阁中收纳着洛岚府搜集而来的诸多引导术，相术，虽说其中大部分都转移到了位于王城的总部中，但这里的老宅依旧还留了不少。
而此处，也算是老宅的重地之一，平日里保护力度不小，巡逻的护卫随处可见。
不过身为少府主，李洛并没有遭受到任何阻拦的就进入到了藏书阁中。
“少府主。”
藏书阁中，有管事的人见到李洛进来，虽然愣了愣，但还是立即恭敬的迎了上来。
李洛点点头，吩咐道：“把藏书阁内，适合四品相的能量引导术都给我找来。”
那管事闻言，心中有些疑惑，以前的李洛即便来藏书阁，也只是看一些相术，能量引导术什么的则是半点不看，因为他天生空相，这些能量引导术对于他而言效果也不大。

不过他可不敢有什么异议，毕竟不管如何，李洛都是少府主，在这老宅中更是拥有着最高的话语权。
于是他立即应下，麻利转身去按照李洛的要求找寻能量引导术。
而李洛则是寻了一间安静的房间，耐心的等了片刻，那管事便是满头大汗的抱了一堆水晶简进来。
“少府主，藏书阁中所有适合四品相修炼的能量引导术都在这里，其中入门级能量引导术有二十八部，将级能量引导术六部。”
李洛点点头，挥手将其遣退，然后开始仔细的翻阅着这些能量引导术。
在这大夏国，能量引导术同样有着等级之分，其分级制度与相力等级相差不多，分为入门级，将级，侯级，王级，而除了入门级外，其余三级，还细分为很庸俗的上中下三品。
入门级的能量引导术，能够让人完成十印境到相师境的入门修炼，而若是想要从相师境踏入将级，那就需要将级的能量引导术，然后以此类推。
入门级能量引导术随处可见，而将级能量引导术则开始出现了区分，唯有一些中级势力，才能够拥有。
而候级能量引导术就更加稀罕了，一些顶尖势力方才能够拥有。
李洛记得，他们洛岚府就有着两部候级能量引导术，正是他爹娘所留下的。
至于王级能量引导术...那珍贵程度就没办法说了，若是真的出现，想必会引起大夏国内诸多顶尖势力的疯狂争夺。
甚至，引发一场大国间的战争也未必不可能。
只不过一般来说，越是高级的能量引导术，其修炼条件也会越苛刻，其中很多都会对修炼者的相性等级有着要求。
现在李洛的“水光相”只是四品，所以他也只能让管事将这些他够资格修炼的能量引导术找来。
时间流逝，桌面上的水晶简被李洛迅速的翻阅完毕。
最终，他从中挑选出了三部能量引导术。
九段吞吐法，将级下品。
沧澜冥想图，将级中品。
灵化诀，将级中品。
三部能量引导术都是属于将级能量引导术，如果修炼到最高层次，自身等级即可突破到将级。

这三部能量引导术品阶潜力尚可，虽然算不上顶尖，但也不是什么大路货，当然最关键的是，刚好能够适用于李洛的四品水光相。
而等他日后若是将他相性的品阶提升起来，到时候再找寻合适的能量引导术转修过去便是，并不会有多大的麻烦。
李洛在三部能量引导术中踌躇了一会，最后选择了那部沧澜冥想图，这部能量引导术修炼而出的相力，特性连绵雄厚如大海，这与李洛的水光相更为的匹配一些。
“就你了。”
李洛大手一挥，收起这“沧澜冥想图”，眼中有着一抹迫不及待之意，然后他直接起身离开，前往了藏书楼的地下密室，那里有着他爹娘专门打造而出的修炼密室。
在这里，他将会开始体验到真正的修炼。
content_en:
The next day, at the gate of the old house.
Li Luo watched Jiang Qing'e's carriage drive away. Next to him, Uncle Liu stood with his hands tied. In addition, there was the tall and plump Cai Wei.
"Huh."
Li Luo watched the motorcade disappear from sight, then breathed out lightly against the morning glow, turned to Uncle Liu and said, "Uncle Liu, help me ask for a week's leave from the school. I want to rest at home for a while."
Right now, due to the fusion of acquired traits, his energy and blood are extremely poor. If he goes to school in this state, he is afraid that it will attract gossip.
Now that he has the water phase, the most important thing is to find an energy guidance technique to practice to increase his phase power level.
Although Nanfeng Academy also has a lot of energy guidance techniques, there are many replacement conditions, which are not as convenient as his own library.
It's just that next month is the big exam. If he takes a week off at this time, I'm afraid it will cause a lot of discussion in the school, but at this time, Li Luo obviously can't care about that.
"Yes, Young Master." Uncle Liu, an honest man, heard the words and immediately agreed.
"Sister Cai Wei." After Li Luo finished speaking, his eyes turned to Cai Wei aside.
Looking at Cai Wei's narrow and charming eyes, she smiled reservedly and said, "What are the orders from the Young Palace Master?"
"I also ask you to help me purchase some spiritual water and strange light. I want it to be of the fourth grade." Li Luo said with a smile.
Cai Wei blinked her thick eyelashes. The spiritual water and strange light were all used to improve the quality of the aspect, but Li Luo seemed to be born with an empty aspect. What do you want with this?
However, although she was confused, she still responded and said in a soft voice: "How many copies does the Young Palace Master need?"
Li Luo thought for a while and said, "Let's buy fifty copies first."
Although Cai Wei is a quite calm and rational mature woman, but when this fifty percent fell into her ears, she stared at Li Luo in shock, as if she felt that she had heard wrongly.
"Young Master, are you talking about fifty portions of fourth-grade spiritual water and strange light?" Cai Wei couldn't help but repeat.
Li Luo met her astonished gaze and nodded seriously.
Cai Wei bit her sexy red lips lightly. Spiritual Water and Qiguang is an expensive thing, and the price of fourth-grade Spiritual Water and Qiguang is not low. On the market, one portion is about one thousand heavenly gold, and fifty copies is 50,000 heavenly gold.
Luolan Mansion has many chambers of commerce and industries in the entire Tianshu County, and their annual income is about 300,000 gold. This situation has gradually declined with the situation of Luolan Mansion over the years.
Of course, the amount of heavenly gold is not really a big problem. Luo Lan Mansion is a big business, and 50,000 heavenly gold will not make Cai Wei lose her composure. However, purchasing fifty copies of the fourth-grade spiritual water and strange light at once seems a bit strange.
Because the main function of the spiritual water and strange light is to quench one's own phase and improve its grade. As we all know, the spiritual water and strange light contain some impurities produced when various materials are fused. This impurity will gradually corrode the phase palace, so over time, it will cause the phase palace to gradually close. At this time, the improvement of the phase will be considered to be the ultimate.
When many people use Lingshui Qiguang, they will not use it without restraint. They will generally control it in an orderly time, such as using about one or two servings a month. This will not only reduce the impact of impurities on their own zodiac signs, but also maximize the use of the quenching power of Lingshui Qiguang.
Therefore, even if others want to buy Lingshui Qiguang, they will only buy in small quantities. Like Li Luo, who buys fifty copies at a time, does this mean he has to save enough for several years?
Cai Wei really couldn't understand why Li Luo did this...
But Li Luo was the young master of the palace after all, and Jiang Qing'e also said that she stayed here mainly to cooperate with Li Luo, so she nodded lightly in the end.
"Okay."
"Then I'll trouble Sister Cai Wei." Li LuoHe smiled gently, then turned around and entered the old house.
Cai Wei looked at his back and sighed helplessly. This young palace master seemed to be a little messy. After what happened yesterday, didn't he still know that Luo Lan Mansion was facing internal and external troubles?
Even if he couldn't share Qing'e's worries due to physical reasons, there was no need to cause trouble, right? According to his squandering methods, Luolan Mansion's annual income from Tianshu County may not be able to withstand the effort for long.
Will I still have to apply for assistance from Jiang Qing'e then? But now the Luolan Mansion is in a bad situation, and it is also a time when it needs a lot of funds.
Cai Wei gently rubbed the center of her eyebrows. It seemed that she might not have a very smooth life in Tianshu County during this period.
As for Cai Wei's many psychological emotions, Li Luo didn't pay too much attention to it. At this time, with some excitement and expectation, he went directly to the library in the old house.
The Library Pavilion contains many guidance techniques and physiognomy techniques collected by Luo Lan Mansion. Although most of them have been transferred to the headquarters in the Royal City, many of the old houses here still remain.
And here, it can be regarded as one of the important areas of the old house. The protection is very strong on weekdays, and patrol guards can be seen everywhere.
However, as the young master of the palace, Li Luo entered the library without encountering any obstruction.
"Young Master."
In the library, the person in charge was stunned when he saw Li Luo coming in, but he immediately greeted him respectfully.
Li Luo nodded and ordered: "Find me all the energy guidance techniques suitable for the fourth grade in the library pavilion."
When the steward heard this, he had some doubts in his heart. In the past, even when Li Luo came to the library, he only looked at some physiognomy techniques and did not look at energy guidance techniques at all. Because he was born with empty physiognomy, these energy guidance techniques were not very effective for him.
But he didn't dare to have any objections. After all, no matter what, Li Luo was the young master of the palace, and he had the highest say in this old house.
So he immediately agreed and quickly turned around to find the energy guidance technique according to Li Luo's request.
Li Luo, on the other hand, found a quiet room and waited patiently for a while. The steward came in with a bunch of crystal slips in his arms, sweating profusely.
"Young Master, all the energy guidance techniques in the library that are suitable for the cultivation of the fourth grade are here. Among them, there are twenty-eight entry-level energy guidance techniques and six general-level energy guidance techniques."
Li Luo nodded, waved his hand to dismiss them, and then began to carefully read through these energy guidance techniques.
In the Great Xia Kingdom, energy guidance techniques are also divided into levels. The grading system is similar to the Xiangli level. It is divided into entry level, general level, marquis level, and king level. In addition to entry level, the other three levels are also subdivided into very vulgar upper, middle and lower grades.
The entry-level energy guidance technique can enable people to complete the introductory practice from the Ten Seal Realm to the fortune teller realm. If you want to step from the fortune teller realm to the general level, you need the energy guidance technique at the general level, and so on.
Entry-level energy guidance techniques can be found everywhere, while general-level energy guidance techniques are beginning to be differentiated, and only some intermediate forces can possess them.
The grade energy guidance technique is even rarer, and only some top forces can possess it.
Li Luo remembered that their Luo Lan Mansion had two grade-level energy guidance techniques, which were left behind by his parents.
As for the king-level energy guidance technique... there is no way to say how precious it is. If it really appears, it will definitely trigger a crazy competition among many top forces in Daxia.
Even triggering a war between major powers may not be impossible.
But generally speaking, the more advanced the energy guidance technique, the more stringent its training conditions will be, and many of them will have requirements for the practitioner's physical level.
Now Li Luo's "Water and Light Phase" is only at the fourth level, so he can only ask the steward to find these energy guidance techniques that he is qualified to practice.Time passed, and Li Luo quickly flipped through the crystal slips on the table.
In the end, he selected three energy guidance techniques.
The nine-stage swallowing method is a low-level general.
Canglan Meditation Chart, mid-level general.
Spirit Transformation Technique, mid-level general level.
The three energy guidance techniques are all general-level energy guidance techniques. If you practice to the highest level, your own level can break through to the general level.
The potential of these three energy guidance techniques is acceptable. Although they are not top-notch, they are not popular. Of course, the most important thing is that they are just suitable for Li Luo's fourth-grade water-light phase.
And if he raises the level of his nature in the future, he can just find a suitable energy guidance technique and transfer to it, and there won't be much trouble.
Li Luo hesitated for a while among the three energy guidance techniques, and finally chose the Canglan Meditation Diagram. The phase force produced by this energy guidance technique has characteristics as continuous and strong as the sea, which is more consistent with Li Luo's water and light phase.
"It's just you."
Li Luo waved his hand and put away the "Canglan Meditation Diagram" with a hint of impatient urgency in his eyes. Then he stood up and left directly, heading to the underground secret room of the library, where there was a secret cultivation room specially built by his parents.
Here, he will begin to experience true cultivation.
